3. The plaintiff's case put in a nutshell are that the suit land of Mouza Chak Bahuka, Police Station Sirajganj, District Pabna (now Sirajganj) appertaining to CS plot no 8415 measuring an area of 9.80 acres was recorded in abstract khatian as Ichchamair river in the names of Dinesh Chandra Chowdhury, and Mutwalli and Akfar Ali Talukder of Amiruddin Wakf Estate during CS operation. Thereafter the said land became cultivable whereupon the plaintiff got ক schedule land measuring an area 1.28 acres from three sons of Dinesh Chandra Roy and Bhupendra Chandra Roy by way of pattan on 15th Aswin, 1348 BS and on 15th Ashar, 1350 BS got খ schedule land measuring an area of 0.55 acres from Akfar Ali Talukder by way of Pattan. The plaintiff executed a kabuliyat in favour of Zamindar for the ক schedule land on 1st Kartik, 1348 BS. Since then the plaintiff has been exercising right, title and possession over the suit land. But during S.A. settlement operation, the land was recorded in abstract khatian of the Government for which the title of the plaintiff was clouded. Hence the suit. 

 19. They lastly submit that the learned Judges of the Courts below concurrently found that the kabuliyat and other relevant documents of the plaintiff were forged and fictitious and the Court of appeal below after reversing the finding of facts regarding adverse possession allowed the appeal which calls for no interference by this Court. 

 22. Ongoing to the materials on record it transpires that the suit land measuring an area of 9.80 acres appertaining to CS plot no 8415 as described in the schedules ক-খ of the plaint was recorded Ichehamai river in the names of Dinesh Chandra Roy Chowdhury and Mutawalli Akfar Ali Talukder of Amiruddin Wakf Estate. The plaintiffs claimed that they got pattan on 1.28 acres of land described in K schedule from the sons of Dinesh Chandra Roy Chowdhury on 15th Aswin, 1348 BS and 0.55 acres of land described in খ schedule from Akfar Ali Talukder on 15th Ashar, 1350 BS by way of Pattans exhibits (1 and lA), Consequently, the plaintiff executed a kabuliyat of the খ schedule land in favour of the Zamindar on 1st Kartik, 1348 BS Since then he is in possession. The defendant No.1 (Government of Bangladesh) claimed that the suit land was the khas land of the Zamindar and subsequently by operation of law the same was vested to the Government as khas land and recorded in abstruck khatian. The added defendant No.2 claimed that he got 2-00 acres of land including the suit land from Mutwalli Akfar Ali Talukder by way of pattan in 1350BS. 

 23. It transpires that the plaintiff instituted the suit for declaration of the title and in support of the title he proved his different as exhibits 1-6, of which exhibits 1-1 (A) are the documents of patans. P.W 1 the plaintiff stated that he executed the kabuliyat being No. 2968 in respect ক schedule land in favour of the Zamindar on 1st Kartik, 1348 BS At the time of trial the respective volume from the concerned registry office was called by the trial Court and on examination of the volume it was detected that the deed No. 2968 is not kabuliyat but a different deed (Exht. B). In view of such facts both the Courts below came to a definite findings that the alleged kabuliyat No. 2968 (exhibit-3) was forged. On appraisal of the materials on record I am also in full agreement with the aforesaid views.
